notes: Amendment No. 1, marked as the final amendment reporting the results, to MSC Income Fund, Inc.'s Schedule TO filed September 26, 2024. fund_type: the filing calls the filer an 'externally managed, non-diversified, closed-end management investment company' and says there is 'otherwise no public market for the Shares'. It runs periodic issuer tenders for liquidity, so it is classed as interval_or_tender_offer_fund. The filing does not use the words 'business development company'; closed_end_fund is the literal alternative. subject_tickers: null; the filing prints no ticker and says the shares have no public market. Size: the offer is for the LESSER of (i) the Shares the Company can repurchase with 90% of the proceeds from Shares issued under its distribution reinvestment plan for the November 1, 2024 dividend, and (ii) 2.5% of the weighted-average Shares outstanding over the prior four calendar quarters. size_pct_outstanding=2.5 is therefore a cap measured against weighted-average shares outstanding, not current shares outstanding, and the DRIP-proceeds leg may bind first. size_shares: null; no maximum share count is stated. The Company bought 512,730 Shares for $3,968,531.78, described as equal to 90% of the DRIP proceeds. price_pct_nav: 100 because the filing says the $7.74 price 'was the net asset value per share as of November 1, 2024' (price = NAV). No percent is printed. commencement_date: taken from the Offer to Purchase date (September 26, 2024), which is also the original Schedule TO filing date; the filing does not say 'commenced'. expiration_date: the filing says the Offer 'terminated' at 5:00 P.M. Central Time on October 28, 2024. proration_factor_pct: null; not stated, and computing it (512,730 / 5,919,194) would be arithmetic. Odd-lot holders (fewer than 100 Shares) who elected priority were not prorated, so a simple ratio would not equal the factor applied to everyone else. conditions: the filing refers only to the terms and conditions in the Offer to Purchase and does not list them.
